track: Original SPIR-V invocation-keyed capture preflight for independent paired FFT trace

approach: Add nonmutating fail-closed preflight that inspects original SPIR-V disassembly, descriptor binding collision, GlobalInvocationId Input type and fetch coordinate/result numeric types.
